title: Dashboard Shell
description: A complete billing overview screen: a sidebar with collapsible sections, a topbar, page actions, section tabs, a dismissible recommendation, a date range panel, ruled metric charts and report downloads. Only the content scrolls.
summary: A full application screen where sidebar, topbar and scrolling content meet.
notes: The shell fills the viewport (--viewport-block) and hides its own overflow: the sidebar and the content area scroll independently and the topbar never moves. Put it at the top of <body>; it is not meant to sit inside a scrolling page.

Actual CSS's .app-layout has the same desktop grid but requires a flat .app-nav that becomes a bottom bar on phones, so this shell is the persistent-sidebar recipe from the navigation-list pattern, scoped to the block. Below 64rem the sidebar is replaced by a native drawer that mirrors it (command="show-modal").

The date range panel is a flyout with preset radios and native date inputs; Apply and Cancel only close it. Applying the range, updating the trigger label and reloading the charts are your application's job. Actual CSS ships no range calendar; a two-month calendar needs an external picker.

The recommendation closes with the dismiss enhancer's command="--dismiss"; remembering that it was dismissed is up to your application. Without JavaScript the menus and the date panel stay closed and the recommendation cannot be dismissed.

Charts are static inline SVG with a text summary each; all figures are sample data. The section tabs are links to other views, marked with aria-current="page", not in-place tab panels. Test mode, search and the download links are placeholders.
